heuristic_efficiency.label: mean quality points per 1k total generation tokens; heuristic only

incremental_value.interpretation_limit: This is a measured outcome/resource profile, not monetary ROI. It does not assign business value to a quality point or assume account-specific token pricing.

fixed_observed_cost_ci.denominator_note: uses the observed mean token overhead as a fixed denominator

primary_metric.name: marginal_quality_yield
primary_metric.unit: blind quality points per 1k additional generation tokens

outcome_construct_profile.analysis_note: Constructs overlap by design and are diagnostic group means, not independent subscales. Their mapping must be frozen before a confirmatory run; mappings added after a run are post-hoc.

constructs.description: Distinguishes a proposed solution from the human situation, develops credible alternative frames, and lets contradictory evidence change the frame.
constructs.label: Right-problem framing

constructs.description: Creates conceptual distance, organizes alternatives, preserves contradictions and outliers, and avoids premature convergence.
constructs.label: Structured divergence and synthesis

constructs.description: Separates evidence, inference, assumptions, synthetic signals, and unknowns while identifying the grounding needed for a consequential decision.
constructs.label: Evidence discipline

constructs.description: Chooses a proportionate prototype or inquiry, defines decision-relevant signals, and updates direction when evidence changes.
constructs.label: Learning-oriented experiments and iteration

constructs.description: Uses Design Thinking when it adds decision value and proceeds directly when requirements or a cheap technical experiment are already clear.
constructs.label: Appropriate scope and momentum

outcome_dimension_profile.analysis_unit: case (judgments average within pair; pairs average within case)

primary_effectiveness_assessment.basis: Design Council is directionally better, but the interval still overlaps the preregistered practical-importance threshold.

resource_efficiency_assessment.basis: The observed token premium exceeded at least one configured resource budget.
resource_efficiency_assessment.interpretation_limit: This is a resource descriptor, not an outcome-value veto or monetary ROI.
